name: 007 ELEMENTS
kurzbeschreibung: 007 ELEMENTS on the 3,048-metre Gaislachkogl peak in Sölden is an awe-inspiring subterranean James Bond cinematic installation at the authentic filming location of Spectre.
preis: Admission charges apply (combined lift & exhibition tickets available)
oeffnungszeiten: Open during cable car operating seasons in summer (June to October) and winter (October to April)
beschreibung:
Überblick

The cinematic installation 007 ELEMENTS sits at a breathtaking altitude of 3,048 metres atop the Gaislachkogl summit adjacent to the cable car top terminal in Sölden, Ötztal. As a globally unique subterranean exhibition, this permanent installation immerses visitors in the world of iconic British secret agent James Bond, specifically highlighting the 2015 blockbuster 'Spectre', whose high-stakes action scenes were filmed at this precise location around the futuristic lift station and the shimmering ice Q restaurant. Designed by acclaimed Austrian architect Johann Obermoser, the raw concrete structure is anchored deeply within the summit's alpine permafrost. Spanning over 1,300 square metres across nine thematic chambers, the experience pairs bespoke spatial soundscapes, original movie props, and digital interactive installations with cantilevered glass apertures offering jaw-dropping views over glaciated valleys.

Route & Anforderungen

Access to the mountaintop installation is seamless and barrier-free, yet the extreme altitude requires thoughtful preparation. The state-of-the-art Gaislachkoglbahn cable car whisks guests up in two seamless stages: first via an 8-passenger gondola to the mid-station (2,174 m), followed by an immense 3S funitel soaring across rugged rock towers to the 3,048-metre terminus. From the top terminal, an enclosed covered pathway leads straight into the museum galleries. In order to protect the fragile permafrost ground, the museum interiors are deliberately left unheated, mirroring ambient mountain temperatures. Warm thermal clothing, gloves, and insulated footwear are imperative even during peak summer months. Visitors prone to cardiovascular concerns should allow ample time to acclimatize to the thin alpine air.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists travel via the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Ötztal) and federal route B186 south directly to Sölden. Spacious covered parking is provided free of charge at the Gaislachkoglbahn valley base station at the southern end of the village. Travelers utilizing public rail arrive at Ötztal Bahnhof and transfer to frequent regional express buses running to Sölden. Reserving timed-entry admission tickets online in advance is highly recommended.

Tipps

Pair your cinematic immersion with fine dining at the adjacent ice Q gourmet restaurant, which starred as the Hoffler Klinik in the movie. Relax with exceptional wine and refined alpine dishes surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass walls suspended above sheer precipices.
